description: The main window may use core APIs and its app commands: report, search, and the F4 overlay's dev_stats, dev_flags, bench_done, and archive_info for the native renderer, and the weather layer's wx_enable, wx_state, wx_frame, wx_satellite, wx_metars, wx_metar, wx_wind, wx_sigmets, wx_satellite_global and wx_prefetch, and the updater's update_check and update_install (which do nothing in a build without an update URL), and set_window_size, which only works in a test run (MAPS_WINDOW_SIZE set).
